title: undefined Full Mock Test 2
instructions: Enhanced ACT format (standard from 2025–26): English 50 questions / 35 min, Math 45 / 50 min, Reading 36 / 40 min are the required core (2h 5m). Science (40 questions / 40 min) is OPTIONAL on the real exam and does not count toward your 1–36 composite — it is reported separately. We include it here so you can practise it; skip it if your target colleges don't need it.
